audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 are marked 'Gragas' in both layers while the whys beside them say the opposite — whys[1] 'Level 2 stays even', whys[2] 'Level 3 remains a skill check'. The packet chart is Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas.
audit.why: The chart is the first thing a player reads on the loading screen; here it claims a lead at 2-3 that the page's own text denies.
audit.corrected: Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas — proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 4-5 (his ult), 6 (reaction duel), first item (your tie-break), 2+ items (AoE outscaling) — consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction line is a placeholder: 'Ultimate', 'his key ability', 'his combo'. Nothing in the page names a single mechanic, and the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice. Two concrete, kit-verified facts are absent: his W pulls from 850 range every 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, and his passive lets him REVIVE once Determination is full.
audit.why: The pull is the tool that drags you into his E-dash and R, and 850 range is longer than your 600-range Body Slam — the spacing rule of the lane. The revive means a burst combo that 'kills' him can be wasted entirely.
audit.corrected: Stay outside 850 range until his W is spent, then E-slam; check his Determination stacks before spending Explosive Cask on the kill, because a full bar revives him. His R is 110s at rank 1 and heals him; his E dash is 10s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits zaahen (P revive text; W 850 range, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12; E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8; R 110/95/80 with heal)
